Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects operation generation, project migration, and the checks before posting.

The named refusal covers the parameter entry points. The migration notes survive a save and load. The review command supports undo. The process declaration is present. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Test results

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2253`. The trial merge with upstream main `e808c96299ef7e1edb3206d327acc270847a8a18` had no conflicts. I used the current upstream `AGENTS.md` for the law check. No GitHub runner was used.

| Target | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| app lib | 355 | 1 |
| app climb_direction | 2 | 0 |
| app mcp | 22 | 0 |
| app mcp_order | 3 | 0 |
| app mcp_verify | 3 | 0 |
| app operation_metadata | 5 | 0 |
| app operations | 120 | 6 |
| app pick_agnostic | 5 | 2 |
| app pocket_no_adaptive | 4 | 0 |
| app pocket_overhead | 2 | 0 |
| app posting | 17 | 0 |
| app predrilled_entry | 8 | 0 |
| app program_entry | 9 | 0 |
| app project_roundtrip | 73 | 0 |
| app rest_pocket | 6 | 0 |
| app roughing2d | 7 | 0 |
| app scripting | 19 | 0 |
| app units_in_refusals | 5 | 0 |
| ui lib | 967 | 6 |
| ui operations | 31 | 0 |

All selected targets built. These tests had no failures. The UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. The ignored tests were not run.

Clippy passed with `-D warnings` for the app library, binaries, and all 17 listed app integration targets. Clippy also passed for all UI targets.

The combined app/UI all-target clippy check stopped on existing upstream errors in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`:

```text
expected Option<WorkMaterial>, found WorkMaterial
missing fields `stepdown` and `stepover` in initializer of CuttingRow
```

That file is identical to upstream main. This agrees with the limit stated in the PR body. The full quick gate was not run.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body:

- Removed the generator refusal in `operation/generate.rs`: `pocket_adaptive_is_refused_at_every_door` failed. Restored the refusal: passed.
- Removed the migration call in `project/apply.rs`: `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` failed. Restored the call: passed.

No golden CL, G-code, or snapshot PNG files changed. There were no moved golden lines to check.

Requested changes

1. **Preserve the review requirement on Copy/Paste.** `crates/app/src/commands/operation/create.rs:206` sets the pasted operation's `needs_review` to an empty list. The UI clipboard also carries only the `Operation`, without these notes. I confirmed the result with a temporary local test: load a legacy operation with dropped rest settings, paste it, delete the source, generate the copy, and post. Posting succeeds without `MarkOperationReviewed`. Carry the notes through the clipboard and paste command, or refuse the copy until review. Add a test that keeps posting blocked for the copy. This is a safety blocker.
2. **Compare the migrated path with independent old output.** `crates/app/tests/pocket_no_adaptive.rs:235` creates the comparison operation from `op.params.clone()` after migration. Both paths therefore use the migrated values. A wrong migrated value can affect both paths and still pass this comparison. Record the old Pocket+Adaptive CL output for the legacy fixture. Compare the migrated output with that record. Issue #1517 requires identical CL across migration.
3. **Keep the Adaptive boss-island coverage.** `crates/app/tests/pick_agnostic.rs:405` replaces Adaptive with OffsetRings. This removes the Adaptive checks for equivalent picks and clearance from the boss. Change the helper to exercise `Adaptive2D` for this case. Keep the existing path and clearance assertions in the heavy lane.
4. **Add before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:354` adds the review banner and button. The PR also changes the strategy list and browser warning. The body has no before/after screenshots. Show these changed states. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

I removed the temporary copy test and restored both mutations. No source changes remain from this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Copy/Paste carries the review notes through the UI clipboard and paste command. Deleting the source does not remove the posting block. `pasted_legacy_operation_requires_review_after_source_deletion` and `clipboard_keeps_review_notes_after_source_is_deleted` pin this. Empty pasted notes and empty clipboard notes each made their test fail. Both restored tests pass.
2. The migration test compares CL with an independent legacy record. The unchanged generator at `a529c455352d8c2d228e3dd83d0e5d42a91ea9b0` produced `pocket_adaptive_v63.cl`. `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` pins this. Halving the migrated feed made the comparison fail. The restored test passes.
3. The heavy boss-island test uses Adaptive2D again. It keeps the equivalent-pick CL and boss-clearance assertions. `a_face_with_an_island_and_its_rim_loop_cut_the_same_bytes_around_the_boss_full` passes in release mode. Replacing Adaptive2D with OffsetRings made its coverage assertion fail. The restored test passes.
4. The PR body links real before/after UI captures. They show the review banner, button, browser warning, and expanded strategy list. Both capture runs passed. The images exist only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, commit `abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1`.

New head: `eda3df83dfbda517ec7f4b96649acda68cd3c336`.

Validation: targeted app clippy and UI all-target clippy pass with `-D warnings`. The quick gate and combined all-target clippy are RED. Both hit unchanged upstream errors in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`: expected `Option<WorkMaterial>` and missing `stepdown`/`stepover`. The gate passed the app library, accessory collision, and adaptive pinch suites. Remaining suites were stopped after the compile failure and quick-gate budget overrun. They are not reported as passed.

The PR remains a draft. Please re-review this head.

The code review is clean. The PR has conflicts with main.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects generation, migration, and the checks before posting.

All four findings from the previous review are addressed:

1. Copy and paste preserve the review notes. The app and UI tests pass after deletion of the source operation.
2. The migration test compares the path with a separate legacy CL record. It no longer builds the expected path from migrated parameters.
3. The heavy island test uses Adaptive2D. Its equivalent-pick and boss-clearance checks pass in release mode.
4. The body links before and after UI images. I downloaded and inspected all four images. They show the requested changed states.

The body has `Process change: yes`, a `Changelog:` line, the breaking-change notice, and `Fixes #1517`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION` or snapshot PNG files.

Local results

I used the current upstream `AGENTS.md`. I attempted a trial merge with upstream main `768834bc7`. It has code conflicts in these files:

- `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`

I aborted the trial merge. All results below are for the PR head in `.claude/worktrees/review-2253`. They do not prove integration with current main. No GitHub runner was used.

| Target | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| app lib | 353 | 1 |

All selected test targets built and passed. The heavy boss-island test took 49.40 seconds after the release build.

Clippy passed with `-D warnings` for the app library, binaries, and these integration targets: `copy_review`, `pocket_no_adaptive`, `pick_agnostic`, and `sinker_side`. UI all-target clippy passed.

Combined app/UI all-target clippy failed on the inherited `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107` errors:

```text
expected Option<WorkMaterial>, found WorkMaterial
missing fields `stepdown` and `stepover` in initializer of CuttingRow
```

That file is unchanged from the upstream commit included in this branch, `e3f7d122b`. Current upstream main has fixed it. I did not change it locally. The full quick gate was not run. The gate dry run passed; it selected 508 steps. A dry run is not a test pass.

Safety mutations

I repeated two mutations reported in the PR body:

- Set pasted review notes to an empty list. `pasted_legacy_operation_requires_review_after_source_deletion` failed because the copied notes were empty. Restored the code: the test passed.
- Halved the feed in the migration. `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` failed against the legacy CL record. Restored the code: the test passed.

I checked all 62 lines of the added `pocket_adaptive_v63.cl`, including the moves, depths, feed values, arc centers, and final retract. No existing golden lines moved.

Requested code changes: none.

Refresh the branch at merge time under the merge-order rules. The conflicts prevent the `merge-ready` label. The merged tree still needs its checks.

Non-blocking note: the new clipboard test grows the existing large `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. A separate test module would improve file size.

Both mutations are restored. The review left no source changes. No review images or logs were committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Stopped without pushing because the quick gate is red on inherited main failures.

The latest review requested no code changes. I resolved the reported conflicts locally by merging upstream main `c5eb07fa14a076bc8b1274164fe54cae571b953a`.

- Kept both the retired Pocket Adaptive refusal and main's named tilt refusal. `pocket_no_adaptive` and `tilt_basis_compat` pass. Removing the tilt refusal made its pin fail. Restoring it passed.
- Kept main's tilt-basis and RTCP format contracts. The review-note barrier now writes v67 because main already writes v66. The migration pin covers v63 through v66 and future-version refusal. Reverting the migration threshold or version barrier made the pin fail. Both restored checks passed.
- Kept both UI refusal warnings after the merge. `rest_group_warns_and_refuses_incompatible_strategy_and_predrilled_on_apply` passes. Removing the added retirement warning made it fail. Restoring it passed.
- `copy_review`, `rest_pocket`, and strict app/UI all-target Clippy pass.

The full quick gate found 18 app test failures across `circular_pick_law`, `keep_law`, `kept_parts_live`, `pocket3d_open_side`, `stock_source_holes`, and `trochoid_law`. A separate baseline at main `c5eb07fa1` reproduced all 18 test names and their exact panic messages. The post is blocked by a program gouge before the operation-specific message those tests expect. I did not change these unrelated checks.

The final-head quick-gate run reproduced the same `circular_pick_law` failure. The remaining steps were stopped using the checkout guard. That run is VOID and is not a completed gate verdict. The earlier full run was red; no gate pass is claimed.

Held local branch: `fix/2253`.
Held local head: `75908b40aacfac1c8bc15d79df16a6e8b4a6c8f3`.
No changes were pushed. The worktree was removed and the committed local branch was kept. The PR remains a draft and existing labels are untouched. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed. `PROCESS_VERSION`, changelog, recommendations, and snapshot PNGs match the merged main.

Please re-review after the upstream blockers are fixed and this refresh is verified and pushed.

Refreshed the conflicts requested by the latest review. No unrelated code changes were made.

- Kept main's named tilt refusal and this PR's Pocket Adaptive refusal. `unknown_saved_basis_is_visibly_refused_before_loading` pins the tilt refusal. Removing it made the test fail. Restoring it passed.
- Kept main's tilt-basis, RTCP, and WCS flip format contracts. The review-note barrier now writes v68 because main writes v67. `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` now covers legacy versions through v67. Lowering the migration threshold or format barrier made the pin fail. Restoring each passed. Future-version refusal also passes.
- Kept main's Zigzag rest support, fixture command changes, and frame timing. Kept the review banner and both Adaptive refusal warnings. `rest_group_warns_and_refuses_incompatible_strategy_and_predrilled_on_apply` pins the warnings. Removing the retirement warning made it fail. Restoring it passed.

The full quick gate passed: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, 531 steps, zero failures. Strict app/UI all-target Clippy passed with `-D warnings`. Copy review, rest machining, project roundtrip, and tilt compatibility checks passed.

New head: `b3746be940994e343d9b41ff06f2d332b0c9d878`.
Merged upstream main: `0a4a86ca19ffe6f94b36f6bd74bcc2607abafde9`.

The PR remains a draft. Existing labels are unchanged. PROCESS_VERSION, changelog, recommendations, and snapshot PNGs match merged main. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.

Please re-review this head.

The head b3746be94 conflicts with origin/main a8bb30f0c. The conflicts are in crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs and crates/ui/src/state.rs. These are real code conflicts. I set the conflicts label. The merge-ready label stands: it records the review, not the merge state. The author re-merges main into the branch.

This PR is now a draft again. The reason: we merge `main` into the branch, and two conflicts need a resolution by hand. The maintainer ordered on 2026-11-18 that conflicting PRs are refreshed now. A ready PR of a collaborator with no author activity for more than 24 hours is refreshed by us. The quick gate runs before the push. A second comment gives the result.

The refresh stops. We did not push. The head of the PR stays `b3746be94`.

The merge of `main` (`983f527bd`) had two conflicts. Both are import lists, and we kept the two sides:

- `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs`: the PR's `MarkOperationReviewed` export and the `StagedGeneration` export from `main`.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`: the PR's `MarkOperationReviewed` import. `main` removed the unused `GenerateOperation` import, and we kept that removal.

The quick gate on the merged tree failed two steps. A second run of the two steps gave the same result (555 steps, 2 failed, 62.6 min):

1. `app suites: pocket_no_adaptive`, test `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` (`crates/app/tests/pocket_no_adaptive.rs:241`). The migrated 2D Adaptive op now cuts only one level at Z18. The recorded legacy Pocket+Adaptive CL has two levels, Z20 and Z18 (32 moves against 60). A change on `main` to the 2D Adaptive generator changed the output. The latest batch on `main` has #2035 (adaptive stock ring). That PR is the first to examine. This is a conflict of the same logic. The PR's promise of an identical toolpath after the migration does not hold on the new `main`. The author must decide: update the recorded CL, or change the migration. We did not change the test or the golden.
2. `app suites: microarc_test_part`, test `a_wrapped_op_on_the_test_part_posts_wrapped_a`. This test also fails on `main` (#2483). It is not related to this PR.

The PR is a draft now (see the comment above). The labels did not change.
